about.title: Ilia Gurevich — founder and agent of GUREVIĆ
about.photo_alt: Ilia Gurevich, founder of the GUREVIĆ agency
about.p1: We are in our third year on the Montenegrin property market. The agency now works in a new format: buyers, tenants, investors and owners each have a separate direction with its own terms and process.
about.p2: Agreements with clients are made in writing. For legal matters, design and construction we work with specialist partners.

steps.title: How we work
steps.sub: Four stages, from your first message to the deal.

s1.title: Request
s1.text: You describe the task: what you are looking for or which property you offer, your timing and budget.

s2.title: Shortlist or valuation
s2.text: We shortlist suitable options or assess your property and agree on the terms of our work.

s3.title: Viewings and negotiation
s3.text: We arrange viewings and negotiate price and terms with the other party.

s4.title: Deal under contract
s4.text: The terms are set out in a written agreement in line with Montenegrin law.

cta.title: Tell us about your plans
cta.text: Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram, or leave a request on the website, and we will get back to you the way you prefer.
cta.languages: Consultations in Russian, English and Montenegrin.
